title: NÆS 02: He Believes in Beauty
edition: NÆS 02 (issue 02 of the NÆS series); official title 'He Believes in Beauty'

description.main: The second issue of NÆS, the photo zine from Elska Magazine, looking back at Liam Campbell's early work as a photographer.
description.extended:
The second issue of NÆS, a photo zine from Elska Magazine, in which founder Liam Campbell looks back at how he became a photographer of men.

The issue is officially titled He Believes in Beauty. It starts with a teenage wish to direct music videos and a later plan to shoot fashion. It then settles on travel and photographing men. Its core years are the ones Campbell spent as a flight attendant, when layovers made his first shoots possible. Sitters include Diego R and Scotty P in Los Angeles, Danny N in Costa Rica, and Alan M and Marco R in London. Elska lists it at 84 pages, full colour, sewn and offset-printed at 170 x 240 mm. A companion, NÆS Ekstra 02, adds twenty-five more men as a 384-page PDF.

Campbell created Elska in 2015 and is its editor-in-chief and chief photographer. The magazine devotes each issue to a different city, and this zine follows NÆS 01: Restless Relentlessly.

notes: Periodical with no ISBN/ISSN found on the publisher page or retailer listing. Year 2026 comes only from the Berkana (libreriaberkana.com) listing 'Release Date: July 2026'; Elska's own pages give no date. Attribution to Liam Campbell as photographer is from the Elska page text (issue about his photographic origins); the page does not have an explicit byline, so consider author 'Elska Magazine'. Beat 3 (2015 start, editor-in-chief/chief photographer, city issues) is from en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elska, fetched; Wikipedia does not mention NÆS. Cover image on publisher site has a pixel-mosaic censor over the genitals; the site offers no uncensored image. Also exists as e-zine PDF ($ not recorded, 84 pp) and a Bundle.
